items.title: Measure seconds per Solana slot from the committed SOL pool archives
acceptance: bot/market/timing.py exposes pure functions over (slot, block_time) pairs and does no network access
tests read only tests/fixtures/launchlab_sol_pools and synthetic samples, and pass with python -W error
the research note reports the measured seconds-per-slot range, the number of pairs, the 1-second block-time quantisation, and states that this is not a measurement of our own orders
the 2-slot latency assumption of bot/market/replay.py is reported in seconds; its default is NOT changed

Optional study of timestamp provenance or measurement bias; no presumed discrepancy against outdated 400 ms reference

items.title: Recompute observed exact-in LaunchLab trade fills from committed SOL fixtures
acceptance: Read only the three committed SOL pool fixtures; no RPC or new data access

For every observed trade, classify whether its instruction/path is supported by exact-in arithmetic; recompute output from the signed pre-state for supported paths and report exact integer mismatches or violations
Document the denominator, fee schedule per pool, number of supported and unsupported trade events, fixture SHA provenance and limitations; do not claim every trade passes if some cannot be modelled
Add offline focused tests and ensure no pre-existing test is weakened

items.title: Measure priority and total network fees from archived SOL pool transactions
acceptance: Use committed transaction metadata only, no network calls
Report observed meta.fee distribution by pool and slot-age bins; if compute-budget instructions can be decoded reliably, separate declared CU price from observed paid fee and document limitations
Do not infer required winning priority fee from observational fees alone or change execution defaults
Provide a reproducible command, dataset counts and offline tests

items.title: Count failed and successful pool-address signatures without survivorship exclusions
acceptance: Read only committed SOL fixture signature listings and report err != null counts and failure proportions by pool and age/slot from pool creation
Explain that address-level signatures are not identical to bot order attempts and cannot alone estimate our own order failure probability
Include empty/partial/malformed fixture tests and a reproducible offline report
Do not create transactions or modify historical archives

items.title: Audit whether genuine Master input features can be reconstructed causally
acceptance: Inspect real decision engine and PR 89 code as read-only references, identifying exact branch SHAs reviewed
List Master inputs and classify point-in-time availability from committed LaunchLab TradeEvents and their transactions versus extra token-account reads or unknown information
Differentiate unavailable fields from negative or zero values and document possible lookahead leakage
Do not execute a truncated Master as if it were genuine; do not change scores, strategy parameters or capital

items.title: Produce a reproducible accounting audit for reference replay cycles
acceptance: Analyze the two available baseline entries from committed SOL fixtures, with stated entry size 0.05 SOL, two-slot assumed latency and each pool's inferred fee rate

Separate curve input and output, actual/assumed transaction network costs, estimated entry and exit amounts, migration and final liquidation flags; identify any values the current replay does not expose rather than inventing them
Report an auditable calculation and differences from the existing baseline report; no claim of profitable Master
Add offline tests and do not alter live trading, strategy thresholds or financial parameters
